fo-1Wd7.title: Coverage: wide strait with islands behind
fo-1Wd7.summary: The trekker west of Skopun looks north over a wide strait with the main islands in the background.

fo-9qa5.title: Houses: black houses with grass roofs
fo-9qa5.summary: A village at the southern tip of the main island has black houses, almost all with grass roofs, plus a small church ruin.

fo-AtU1.title: Sign: yellow direction sign, thin black border
fo-AtU1.summary: Yellow direction signs with a thin black border and a metal frame. Almost the same as Iceland's.

fo-COV6.title: Houses: wood with stone base, grass roofs
fo-COV6.summary: Wooden houses, often on a raised stone basement painted a different colour. Roofs are metal or covered in grass (turf).

fo-Le4A.title: Coverage: low narrow peninsula, island trekker
fo-Le4A.summary: On the small island of Koltur, the trekker usually shows a narrow, low peninsula at the island's southeastern tip.

fo-MWOi.title: Coverage: very low clouds around a peninsula
fo-MWOi.summary: The trekker on Eiðiskollur shows extremely low clouds surrounding the peninsula.

fo-RQyZ.title: Coverage: village below snowy mountains
fo-RQyZ.summary: The trekker by Gjógv looks south over the village, with snow-covered mountains behind.

fo-RbUF.title: Google car: black car, plain grey roof rack
fo-RbUF.summary: All Gen 3 car coverage is a black car with a plain grey roof rack. No other country with a similar landscape has a car like it.

fo-V3eT.title: Landscape: two pyramid mountains, thin snow
fo-V3eT.summary: The trekker on Klakkur sees two distinct pyramid-shaped mountains to the south, with a very thin layer of snow.

fo-XXhd.title: Boat: grey boat with reflective clothing
fo-XXhd.summary: A grey boat with several people in reflective clothes and the text 'RIB62' heads to Koltur island.

fo-awY5.title: Landmarks: wind parks
fo-awY5.summary: Three wind parks exist: the largest northwest of the capital, one northeast of it, and one east of Vestmanna.

fo-ddcl.title: Google car: blurred black pickup, front antenna
fo-ddcl.summary: Gen 4 coverage uses a black pickup truck, always blurred, with an antenna on the front. Iceland's truck has no similar antenna.

differs.how: Icelandic truck has no front antenna

fo-g4Xq.title: Landscape: steep green mountains from fjords
fo-g4Xq.summary: Long wide fjords with jagged green mountains rising straight out of the water and rocky ridge lines. Looks greener and more imposing than Iceland's coast.

differs.how: Iceland's coastal mountains are less green and less imposing

fo-ggio.title: Guardrail: yellow reflectors
fo-ggio.summary: Guardrails carry yellow reflectors. No other northern European country does this.

fo-iisY.title: Landscape: narrow fjord with steep hills
fo-iisY.summary: The second biggest town sits by a narrow fjord with steep hills running roughly north to south.

fo-q4k2.title: Plants: almost no natural trees
fo-q4k2.summary: Almost no trees grow naturally, so bare green hillsides are normal.

fo-q721.title: Language: Ð and Á letters, plus Ø
fo-q721.summary: Uses Á, Ð, Í, Ó, Ú, Ý, Æ and Ø. Seeing Ø separates it from Icelandic, which uses É and Þ instead.

differs.how: Iceland uses É and Þ, not Ø

fo-u8Th.title: Bollard: small wooden stick, yellow top
fo-u8Th.summary: Small wooden sticks, mostly painted yellow and sometimes red on top.

fo-vpGT.title: Towns: only place with tall buildings
fo-vpGT.summary: The biggest town is the only place with buildings over three floors. The surrounding landscape is fairly open, especially to the east.
